parameters.text:
={{
  "ARTICLE DATA
" +
  "Title: " + $json.title + "
" +
  "Description: " + $json.description + "
" +
  "Published At: " + $json.publishedAt + "
" +
  "Article URL: " + $json.canonicalUrl + "

" +
  "FULL ARTICLE:
" + $json.content + "

" +
  "AGENT INSTRUCTIONS:
" + $json.agentInstructions + "

" +
  "CONTENT GUIDELINES:
" + $json.contentGuidelines + "

" +
  "TASK:
" +
  "Analyze the article and create a content plan for an Instagram carousel.

" +
  "Determine:
" +
  "1. Main news angle.
" +
  "2. Key facts and supporting information.
" +
  "3. Important data, figures, and findings.
" +
  "4. Recommended narrative flow for a maximum of 6 slides.
" +
  "5. Key message for each slide.
" +
  "6. Suggested caption and relevant hashtags.

" +
  "Use only information supported by the article.
" +
  "Do not invent facts, statistics, or quotations.
" +
  "Do not create visual designs yet."
}}

options.systemMessage: You are a content strategist for Rumah123, an Indonesian property portal. Follow the instructions supplied in the prompt.

parameters.text:
={{
  (() => {
    const example = {
      carousel: { topic: "...", slide_count: 6, aspect_ratio: "4:5", canvas: { width: 1080, height: 1350, format: "png" } },
      caption: { text: "...", hashtags: ["..."], call_to_action: "..." },
      slides: [{ slide_number: 1, purpose: "...", headline: "...", body: "...", key_facts: [], visual: { subject: "...", type: "...", description: "...", asset_status: "to_generate" }, layout: { composition: "...", background: "...", text_alignment: "left", visual_position: "..." } }]
    };
    return "CONTENT PLAN:
" + $json.output + "

" +
      "BRAND GUIDELINES:
" + $json.brandGuidelines + "

" +
      "CREATIVE GUIDELINES:
" + $json.creativeGuidelines + "

" +
      "OUTPUT SPECIFICATION:
" + $json.outputSpecification + "

" +
      "TASK:
" +
      "Create the complete Instagram carousel design based on the content plan.

" +
      "DESIGN REQUIREMENTS:
" +
      "1. Create between 1 and 6 slides. Do not force 6 slides; the number depends on the amount of information.
" +
      "2. Create a unique visual layout for each slide.
" +
      "3. Follow all brand and creative guidelines.
" +
      "4. Keep all facts and figures consistent with the source article.
" +
      "5. Design each slide in portrait 4:5 format (1080x1350 px).
" +
      "6. Provide clear visual concepts and image-generation instructions for every slide.
" +
      "7. Ensure text hierarchy, readability, and consistent branding.

" +
      "OUTPUT STRUCTURE RULES:
" +
      "1. Return exactly ONE carousel object.
" +
      "2. Return exactly ONE caption object for the entire carousel.
" +
      "3. Return slides as an array containing 1-6 slide objects.
" +
      "4. NEVER put caption or carousel objects inside individual slide objects.
" +
      "5. Each slide must contain only its own content, visual instructions, and layout.
" +
      "6. Include slide_number, purpose, headline, body, key_facts, visual, and layout in each slide.
" +
      "7. The caption must contain text, hashtags, and call_to_action.
" +
      "8. Do not repeat caption, hashtags, or carousel metadata inside slides.
" +
      "9. slide_count must equal the real number of slides.

" +
      "EXPECTED JSON STRUCTURE:
" + JSON.stringify(example, null, 2) + "

" +
      "Return valid JSON only. No markdown code fences or explanations.";
  })()
}}

options.systemMessage: You are a senior carousel designer for Rumah123. Output valid structured JSON only, following the supplied output specification.

parameters.prompt:
=={{
  "SLIDE DATA:
" + JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) + "

" +
  "TASK:
" +
  "Create a detailed image-generation prompt for this Instagram carousel slide.

" +
  "INSTRUCTIONS:
" +
  "- Follow the headline, key facts, and visual description.
" +
  "- Create a professional editorial design for Rumah123.
" +
  "- Use Indonesian language for all displayed text.
" +
  "- Include the exact headline and key facts.
" +
  "- Create clear typography, hierarchy, spacing, and visual composition.
" +
  "- Use portrait 4:5 format, 1080x1350 pixels.
" +
  "- Do not invent or alter facts.

" +
  "Return only the complete image-generation prompt."
}}
